highlights.headline: Fossil-fuel industry accused of violating Colorado law over not disclosing drilling chemicals
highlights.summary: <p>Non-profit FracTracker Alliance alleges regulators have exempted compounds used in drilling despite 2022 law</p><p>The fossil-fuel industry is violating Colorado law by not disclosing which chemicals it uses in drilling, a new <a href="https://fractracker.org/2026/11/colorado-oil-gas-chemical-disclosure-2026/">analysis</a> by the FracTracker Alliance non-profit alleges, and state records show it has used illegal or dangerous compounds while fracking.</p>&lt
